method: built-in image generation from owner-provided screenshot style reference; uniform fit and composition on exact existing substrates
style_reference: Owner-provided Civilization V Strategic View screenshot; source screenshot is not included in this repository

export.fit: Uniform scaling of entire relief silhouette into approved pointy/flat regular hex; no geometric clipping of artwork
export.background: Exact grass.png for open hills and stone.png for mountains

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create original GAME TERRAIN SPRITE artwork matching the actual supplied Civilization V STRATEGIC VIEW screenshot (image 1). Follow its specific relief rendering: small softly painted oblique cartographic terrain, modeled by broad cream sunlit faces and quiet olive/grey shaded slopes. No drawn outline around forms. Fine simplified ridges, soft-edged feet; recognizable at very small map scale. It is a schematic game-map sprite with painted volume, not a vector icon, a cartoon sticker, or an elaborate landscape painting.
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE only: inspect its rounded hill clusters and single tall mountain; ignore the phone interface, black hex borders, rivers, resource badges and selection outlines. Do not reproduce any UI. Image 2 is the exact substrate material/color reference that will be composited underneath later, not a background to add now.
Output ONE isolated relief sprite on actual TRANSPARENT background. All nontransparent artwork including the compact local contact shadow is the relief only. No opaque square, no hex-shaped ground or border, no platform, no bloom, mist, haze or glow, no long cast shadow. Do not draw a full scene. The foot of each slope should be complete and natural, not cut off by straight polygon edges. Leave transparent space outside the terrain and between distinct outer footlines. Keep all art upright. All visible terrain must fit the specified regular-hex composition, with no clipping or chopped tips. The final 210x210 tile will contain a full square substrate with only this sprite placed on it.
Primary visual rule: NO BLACK OR DARK STROKE OUTLINES, NO INK CONTOURS, NO THICK EDGES, NO FLAT VECTOR FACETS. Form must come from the same softly graded painted light/shade as the source screenshot. Matte soft low-detail terrain, subdued natural colors. No trees, forests, grass tufts, rocks as separate props, buildings, roads, rivers, symbols, letters, numbers or decorative marks. Keep image clean enough for a 50-pixel map hex.
Specific asset: OPEN HILLS: one coherent group of 4-6 low rounded earthen knolls, with small light beige/ivory rounded tops and warm olive grassy slopes, the same low hill-plateau silhouettes visible repeatedly in the screenshot. Compact low relief, no jagged or pointed peaks. Sunlit left slopes, softly shaded right slopes. Overall TALLER / pointy-top-hex arrangement: an upper-center knoll with staggered broad knolls underneath, tapering toward the lower center. Spread the complete knoll cluster generously over the hex interior, leaving the actual original grass texture visible around it. Do not make giant stacked green cushions. Do not make a solid polygon-shaped block.
